description: Open one remote browser in the cloud with the connected CloudBrowser account. Use it only for websites and accounts that the user owns or is authorized to use, and follow their terms. Browsers open without stealth fingerprints.

browser.description: Browser type: 0 = Chrome, 2 = Chromium, 3 = ChromeHeadlessShell. Default 0

headless.description: Indicates whether the browser should open in headless mode (true) or with GUI (false). Default false

keepOpen.description: Seconds of inactivity before browser closes automatically. Value 0 is never, default 300 seconds

label.description: Specifies the instance name, useful for recognizing it in the list of open remote desktops

recoverSession.description: If true, loads the label when starting a previous session (if it exists), to know which session we save/restore. Default false

saveSession.description: If true, browser session is saved periodically and at the end, cookies and local storage, but not open tabs. Default false

name: open_browser
